name: Tanarukk
traits: Medium Outsider (Native). +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Wisdom, −4 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Fire resistance 10. Spell resistance is 14 + class levels.

The natural bite deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage before Strength. In a full attack with a weapon, apply a −5 penalty to the bite attack and add half the Strength bonus to its damage.

Control Flame (Sp), 1/day, caster level 5. As a standard action, change an existing nonmagical fire within 10 ft. Dim it to coals or brighten it to daylight brightness and twice its normal illumination radius. The effect lasts 5 minutes. Heat output and fuel consumption stay the same.
Orc Blood allows the tanarukk to use or create items with orc-specific powers as an orc.

Five racial Hit Dice (5d8) grant BAB +5, base Fortitude +4, Reflex +4, Will +4, and two feats. Racial skill points are 8 × (8 + Intelligence modifier). The racial class skills are Hide, Intimidate, Listen, Search, and Spot.
LA +3. ECL 8 before class levels and ECL 9 with one class level. Favored class Barbarian.

Abyssal and Orc are automatic. Add the home region’s automatic languages and choose bonus languages by region. The original entry describes tanarukks as illiterate until they take a PC class other than Barbarian.
Underdark supplies the 3.5 advancement entry and refers to Races of Faerûn for the detailed playable rules.
